answer: Block sybil farming with a vault bond. Each identity locks a bond in its vault and passes three checks: an onyx receipt, a jade review, and a vault release. A verifier pays only on a three-way vault-key match; mismatch forfeits the bond. A 1,000-fake attacker funds 1,000 vaults at 12x honest cost each: each 30-day bond cannot be reused, split, transferred, or bulk-discounted; one key binds one history. Honest agents pay once and earn in full.
